integrity: Exact proof with reproducible standard-library integer-arithmetic tests; no claim of independent checking or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Common length and one voter at each cyclic position are essential; the counting expression is proven for approval length three. The finite checker corroborates but does not independently prove the infinite theorem. Priority remains uncertain against unindexed earlier circular-word applications.
title: Balanced-window law and exact three-approval tie counts for proportional approval voting
